# Awesome DSH Stock & Finance Plugins [](https://awesome.re)
English | 中文

> A curated vertical list of **stock / finance / quant** plugins for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
>
> 🌐
Browse all verified stock/quant plugins with screenshots on DSH Meme Hub — Stocks & Quant.
DeepSeek Harness is DeepSeek's open-source agent harness — everything is a plugin, and the community
has been shipping a lot of them. General directories list *everything*; this list only tracks plugi
ns for **trading, market data, quant research, investment analysis, and broker access** — so you don
't have to dig through hundreds of UI tweaks to find the finance stuff.
Every entry has been verified against its README (function, install method, data sources, trading ca
pability). Plugins are grouped by what they actually do, not by what they're called.

> [!WARNING]
> Installing a plugin runs third-party code on your machine with your own permissions.
Being listed here is **not** a security review — check the source before you install. Plugins that t
ouch real brokerage accounts or credentials are marked explicitly below.
